prompt: Create a cinematic vertical street photograph in a gritty urban alley at golden hour, showing a real young goth-punk woman with black teased shaggy hair standing on the left side of a concrete utility pole and leaning toward a wall mural on the right as if flirting with or meeting her illustrated alter ego. She wears a dark oversized plaid flannel shirt, black layered top, studded belt, ripped black skinny jeans, fingerless gloves, layered necklaces, heavy eyeliner, dark lipstick, and tall black platform lace-up boots with buckles; one boot is lifted behind her in a playful pose, her hands resting on the pole, gaze turned toward the drawing. The environment is a narrow weathered alley with cracked asphalt, rough stucco walls, metal pipes, stickers, faded graffiti tags, grime, and warm backlit sunlight creating long shadows and shallow depth of field. On the right wall, draw exactly 1 large black ink graffiti-style cartoon character matching her punk aesthetic: wild long black hair, huge laughing smile, plaid shirt, ripped pants, platform boots, one leg kicked up, leaning toward the pole; surround it with exactly 9 doodle elements: 2 hearts above, 1 skull speech bubble, 3 five-point stars, and 3 short motion/emphasis line clusters. Make the mural look hand-drawn directly on the wall in messy expressive black marker lines, while the real person remains photorealistic. Use high-detail textures, natural lens blur, moody fashion-editorial lighting, rebellious cute punk energy, and a realistic color grade with muted browns, charcoal blacks, and warm highlights. No extra people, no readable brand logos, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张电影质感的竖构图街头摄影作品，背景设在黄金时刻粗犷的都市小巷中。画面左侧站着一位真实的年轻哥特朋克女性，她留着 黑色蓬松凌乱发型，身体倚靠在混凝土电线杆上，向右侧的墙面壁画倾斜，仿佛正在与画中的另一个自己调情或邂逅。她身穿深色超大款格子法兰绒衬衫、黑色叠穿上衣、铆钉腰带、破洞黑色紧身牛仔裤，佩戴露指手套和多层项链，画着浓重的眼线和深色唇膏，脚蹬带有搭扣的高帮黑色厚底系带靴；她的一只靴子俏皮地向后抬起，双手扶在电线杆上，目光转向墙上的涂鸦。环境是一条狭窄且饱经风霜的小巷，地面是开裂的沥青，墙面是粗糙的灰泥，配有金属管道、贴纸、褪色的涂鸦标签和污垢，温暖的逆光营造出长长的阴影和浅景深效果。在右侧墙上，绘制 1 个与她朋克风格相符的大型黑色墨水涂鸦风格卡通角色：留着狂野的长黑发，露出大大的笑脸，穿着格子衬衫、破洞裤，脚蹬厚底靴，单腿踢起，向电线杆方向倾斜；在角色周围绘制 9 个涂鸦元素：上方 2 个爱心、1 个骷髅对话气泡、3 个五角星以及 3 组简短的动态/强调线条。壁画看起来像是直接用凌乱且富有表现力的黑色记号笔手绘在墙上的，而真人部分则保持照片级的写实感。采用高细节纹理、自然的镜头模糊、情绪化的时尚编辑灯光、叛逆可爱的朋克能量，以及带有柔和棕色、炭黑色和暖色高光的写实调色。画面中没有其他人，没有可辨认的品牌标志，没有水印。
